toxicity_gap.impact: Nonblocking caution: DRAMP says no hemolysis data in the reference; primary source provides antibacterial and stability assays but no mammalian toxicity row.

cautions: No true supplementary assets were available; source review used primary XML/PDF/OA package and database snapshots.
Primary Table 3 reports B. cereus ATCC 14578 while methods/Table 1 use ATCC 14579; the value is preserved as reported rather than normalized.
Primary Table 4 caption uses E. coli ATCC 13076 as stability indicator; this is retained as a source caution because other E. coli assay locators use ATCC 25922/29522.
